title: Massachusetts State Payroll
scope: This ledger ranks Commonwealth departments on CTHRU calendar-2025 payroll (pay_total_actual), reports Comptroller-recorded spending for fiscal 2025, and also reports CTHRU quasi-public payroll for calendar 2025 and a vendor-only extract of non-payroll object classes for FY 2025.
exclusions: Does not cover municipal payroll (Boston City Payroll or Massachusetts Town Profiles), retiree pensions (DL-05), named-employee lookups, or advice about a contract bid.
heritage: Formerly Payroll State Agencies, Higher Education, Quasi Public Agencies, and Vendor Payments
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from CTHRU Commonwealth Of Massachusetts Payroll v4 (Socrata 9ttk-7vz6), calendar 2025, summed by department_division. Named employees are not published here. Spending is the Comptroller file pegc-naaa, budget fiscal year 2025, all object classes. Calendar 2026 payroll is year-to-date and is not the headline. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

SRC-630-04.supports: This ledger ranks Commonwealth departments on CTHRU calendar-2025 payroll (pay_total_actual), reports Comptroller-recorded spending for fiscal 2025, and also reports CTHRU quasi-public payroll for calendar 2025 and a vendor-only extract of non-payroll object classes for FY 2025.

q: Massachusetts state, higher-ed, and quasi-public payroll, plus vendor payments.
lead: Commonwealth payroll totaled $10.89 billion in calendar 2025 across 162,473 employee rows (SRC-630-01). UNIVERSITY OF MASSACHUSETTS SYSTEM (UMS) was the largest department at $1.82 billion (SRC-630-01). Comptroller-recorded spending was $98.33 billion in fiscal 2025 (SRC-630-02). Quasi-public payroll totaled $352.80 million in calendar 2025 across 3,238 rows (SRC-630-03). MASSPORT was the largest quasi-public employer (SRC-630-03). The largest non-payroll vendor in FY 2025 was UMS - SUMMARY TRUST PAYMENT at $2.40 billion (SRC-630-04).
